title: After publishing a website, the editor shows a View live site link beside Publish

source.ref: Toni House of Fates QA audit 2026-11-16 (project thread), item 3

detail:
EVIDENCE: components/sites/editor/shell.tsx (the save callback, ~line 427) announced a publish with a 'Published to <host>' toast and nothing to click. The only way to the live site was a small 'Live site' link in the left rail foot, which the audit's owner did not find, so after her first publish she could not tell where her site was.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: a publish (not a schedule) now puts a 'View live site' link in the toolbar right beside Publish, opening https://<host>/ in a new tab (rel noopener noreferrer, labelled as opening a new tab). Covered in both toolbars: the Frequency one (FQ_EDITOR, live in production) and the legacy one. The link stays for the rest of the session. The toast is unchanged. Test: components/sites/editor/shell.frequency.test.tsx.

verify.note: Fails on main: a publish only raises a toast and no toolbar link to the live site exists. Passes once a publish turns on a new-tab View live site link to https://<host>/ beside Publish in both toolbars.
